title: University of Miami Dwayne Johnson Locker Rooms
address:
5811 San Amaro Drive
Coral Gables, Florida 33146
United States
description:
Located on the second floor of the Schwartz Center, connected to the Hecht Athletic Center on the north side of the University of Miami campus, this locker room was funded and sponsored by former Hurricanes player Dwayne Johnson.

Each player has a custom gear bin with an integrated lockbox, phone charging, and dedicated shoe and clothing compartments, along with specialized racks for drying shoulder pads and gear after practice. A backlit U logo set into the ceiling keeps the team's mark off the floor underfoot. The space also includes audio-visual equipment for team meetings, direct access to the practice fields, a nutrition and snack area, large-screen TVs, comfortable seating, and lockers and plaques honoring former Hurricanes greats by jersey number.
